gallery.title: The gallery
gallery.lead: Art that celebrates compassion for animals. Explore work shared with permission by participants and their families.
gallery.detailLead: A closer look at the work, the artist's approved credit and the story behind it.
gallery.empty: There are no artworks to show here yet. Visit again after the next competition.
gallery.illustration: AI illustration — sample artwork, not a participant's submission
gallery.reportLead: Tell FOA if an artwork, its story or credit worries you. You don’t have to give your name.
gallery.sent: Thank you. FOA will review your report.
gallery.invalid: We couldn’t send your report. Please check the details and try again.
gallery.rate_limited: You have reached the hourly report limit. Please try again later.
gallery.noScript: If JavaScript is unavailable, open the simple report form.
gallery.plainUnavailable: The simple form is temporarily unavailable. Please try later or contact FOA.

admin.title: Gallery curation
admin.lead: Review images and public text before publishing. Consent and a safe stamp are required at publication and on every public request.
admin.review: Review title and story. Remove any personal details, such as a name, school, address or contact information. Confirm the image is suitable for public display before publishing.
admin.pending: Stamped copy is not ready. Refresh this page after the worker runs.
admin.denied: This action is not available to your role.
admin.error: The gallery change could not be saved. Check consent, review and the current state.
admin.reportLead: Review concerns and hide artwork immediately where needed. Reports and contact details are private to authorised content staff.
